title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions, and bump deps
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: our mono CI workflow has grown slow and brittle — lint, unit tests, integration tests and release automation are serialized and cause long queue times. This PR splits the workflow into separate, cache-aware jobs (lint, unit, integration, release) and modernizes actions to current stable versions to improve parallelism, cache hit rates, and security posture. What changed: consolidated and split .github/workflows into three focused workflows (lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml); upgraded GH Actions (checkout v4, setup-node v4, actions/cache v4) and bumped key dev dependencies in package.json across ts/py SDKs to reduce security warnings; added a shared action template for matrix caching; added gating to skip expensive e2e on dependabot/auto PRs. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and validated job-level caching - [x] Upgrade actions and node versions where safe (node 20 matrix preserved for build) - [x] Added lightweight smoke step for release workflow to prevent accidental publishes - [x] Kept release automation behavior identical (tags and changelog generation preserved) - [x] Sanity run on redwood monorepo (see CI run 420999-1) Testing notes: ran full matrix against main and a feature branch. Lint and unit tests now run in parallel and reduce median pipeline time by ~35% in our sample runs. Integration test job still sequential to preserve resource ordering but benefits from cache improvements. Release job executed successfully in dry-run mode; published artifacts were not released in this PR. Impact: improves developer feedback loop, reduces CI queue pressure during peak hours, and reduces surface for action CVEs by upgrading to maintained action revisions. No runtime production changes. Related: ENG-2314 (CI reliability workstream), ENG-2330 (release automation hygiene)
commits: feat(ci): split workflows into lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml
chore(ci): upgrade actions/checkout to v4 and setup-node to v4
chore(deps): bump eslint @typescript-eslint/prettier configs and yarn lock refresh
feat(ci): introduce matrix caching template and reuse in test workflow
chore(ci): add skip rules for dependabot and docs-only PRs
test(ci): run dry-release step with GPG disabled for safety

release_notes: Split CI workflows into targeted lint/test/release pipelines, upgraded GH Actions to v4 where applicable, and bumped dev dependencies to remediate warnings. Improves CI throughput and security posture; no runtime changes.
